# Wiki rules index (generated by tools/wiki_rules.py; do not edit)

Cache fetched 2026-10-19: 302 keyword pages (Category:Keywords) and 12 rules pages. 179 keyword pages name a keyword used by staged cards; 86 of them have a format / default-text section (the template sentence of the keyword). Read a page locally with `python3 tools/wiki_rules.py --show "<page>" [--section "<heading>"]`; never copy wiki text into the repo (skill `bs-wiki-rules`).

"Waiting" = staged cards whose keyword field or text names the keyword (approximate, a name like "Charge" also matches "Core Charge"); "Playable" = shipped cards whose text names it. "Format" = the heading that holds the template sentence ("lead" = in the opening text). "Mechanic" = the entry in `data/glossary/mechanics.json` (status from there; "-" = no entry with that slug).
